title: A Bumblebee Queen Can Survive a Whole Week Underwater

scenes.text: A bumblebee queen can survive a week underwater.
Scientists held queens under water for up to a week. They still came back to life.
A new study says they seem to breathe down there, pulling oxygen out of the water around them.
Queens spend winter hibernating in soil, where spring floods can bury them for days.
Eight days under, and the survivors still recovered.
A week underwater. So yes, a bumblebee queen survives it.

description:
A bumblebee queen can survive up to a week underwater.
Researchers found that hibernating common eastern bumblebee queens appear to breathe while submerged, taking oxygen from the water around them. A 2026 study reported survivors after eight days under.
Would you believe a bee could last a week under water? Comment below.
thumbnail_text: QUEEN BEE SURVIVES A WEEK UNDERWATER
first_comment: Bumblebee queens hibernate in soil, so a flooded spring could bury them. This may be how they survive it. What animal would you least expect to breathe underwater?
